turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Sofia! Hope your Thursday is going well. How's the heat in Phoenix today, and how are you feeling after recovering from that flu?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! I'm feeling 100% back to normal, thank goodness. The Phoenix heat is brutal today, though—it's already scorching. I actually had to make myself some chilled, overnight-steeped coffee concentrate this morning just to cool down and wake up.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, cold brew is absolutely essential for a Phoenix summer morning! I'm so glad you're fully recovered. Are you heading into the hospital for a night shift today, or do you have some time off?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I do have a shift tonight. Since I was running a bit late and didn't want to walk from the far parking lot in this heat, I just ordered a car through an app to get me there.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That makes total sense—saving your energy and staying in the AC is definitely the way to go. Did you have a good soundtrack or something to listen to on the way over?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! I put on a funny audio show where a couple of stand-up comedians just banter and tell jokes. It really helped take the edge off my pre-shift anxiety.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A comedy podcast is the perfect way to prep for a busy night. How have things been at the ER lately? Has the summer rush started to slow down at all?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not really, we're still seeing a ton of heat-related issues. But it's manageable. Tom actually met up with me right after my shift yesterday morning to grab a quick coffee, which was a nice little boost.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That is so thoughtful of Tom! Having that support must make those long night shifts a lot easier to handle. Have you two had any time for salsa dancing lately, or has your schedule been too packed?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We actually managed to slip away for some salsa dancing last Saturday! It was so much fun to just let loose and move.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a wonderful way to unwind! And how is your sourdough baking going? Have you been feeding your starter lately?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, with this heat, turning the oven on sounds like torture. My starter is currently taking a long nap in the back of the fridge. I'll revive it when autumn finally rolls around!
